source: Same installed x86-64 macOS Sequoia guest under REIMS; actual 1080p forest screensaver on RTX 2080 Ti / NVIDIA driver 580.126.09.
method: 3 full-VM 60-s valid trials per arm. Equal-frequency 1 Hz NVIDIA utilization/power/decoder/encoder/graphics-clock sensor; 32 QEMU full RGB 1920x1080 captures before and after each; per-second REIMS presentation stats; QEMU CPU time from /proc/pid/stat. No streaming encoder activity. Both variants same physical GPU and macOS installation.

excluded.reason: Full run did not hold 30 guest presentations/s; 27.93220338983051/s reported by strict QEMU presentation-stat gate. Sampled moving frames did pass but GPU utilization was intentionally not saved or used.
Pre-sample 32-frame QEMU motion test failed during transient warm-up presentation stall; no GPU sample was started.

limitations: Single NVIDIA host and one macOS guest. Full matching means same disk, 1080p forest workload, GPU and compose configuration except QEMU image, not bit-identical runtime behavior or guaranteed identical sequence phase.
M2V source pinned and unmodified, with REIMS source API adapter and two root-vs-buffer-generation device identity compatibility corrections.
NVIDIA utilization is an averaged busy-percentage sensor, not measured framebuffer throughput or energy. Board power and CPU have uncontrolled within-guest activity.
The 76.7% to ~19.8% historical baseline/correction experiment compares a different prior integration, not these master-versus-accepted arms.
One invalid full master trial and one invalid pre-sample accepted attempt are excluded from steady 30 Hz aggregate; no GPU result is imputed for them.
